# Authoring notes

- Built `index.html` as a standalone, responsive static page; no dependencies, scripts, external requests, or generated media.
- Direction: full-bleed geometric poster, teal/cream palette, system Georgia/Arial, square Explore anchor to `#work`. Hero crop: 75% center desktop, 73% center mobile; breakpoint: 700px.
- Media: verified local `assets/poster.svg`; repository fixture rights recorded in `assets/rights.json`. Selected static poster treatment; no entrance animation, autoplay, or video source. Hover transition: 200ms, disabled for reduced motion.
- Requested footage was not supplied. The rights manifest mentions `scene.webm`, but that file is absent. No video URL invented; a visible caption states the limitation.
- Validation: basic shell content/asset checks only. Browser rendering, responsive behavior, keyboard interaction, and video playback remain unverified; central observer owns qualification.
